heading: Implementation overlays (IRET)
text:
## Implementation overlays (IRET) [LNLS.6]

`linear_scan: false` changes what the reference engine may assume at load and
in the pump path. Those changes are stated where an implementer will
look for them — beside the base behaviour they supplement, in the
implementation tree:

- [IRET.7.5.1] — the equality anchor is extracted at load, and the
  join-test hot path becomes O(1) for it.
- [IRET.6.2.1] — alpha tests over types known at node-creation time,
  and the `capacity` bound that makes a regex test's cost a
  compile-time constant.
- [IRET.9.8] — the expression kinds the exclusions in [LNLS.3] make
  unreachable.

They supplement, and do not replace, the base behaviour. The
guarantees they serve are stated as properties in [LNLS.5.1] and
[LNLS.5.3].
